items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs DET as details finalized. Time in AZ done; trade expected after Sunday games. Houston among teams with interest.
items.why: Team finalizing trade deal; told player this morning.
items.implication: Zero fantasy value this week; long-term destination TBD (HOU interest for Stroud reunion).
items.opportunity: Full target vacuum for remaining ARI pass catchers.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 5 (hamstring). Confirmed on final injury report.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week; final report OUT vs JAC in London.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee or backup elevation; zero points.
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining PHI RBs and pass game.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 5 (ankle).
items.why: Ankle injury; DNP; final OUT vs ATL.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Ravens offense downgrade, Likely/Henry usage shifts.
items.opportunity: Isaiah Likely and Ravens skill players still viable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (quad). Also AD Mitchell OUT.
items.why: Quadriceps; DNP Wed-Fri; Out vs CLE.
items.implication: Jets RB handcuff/backup full workload opportunity.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries for Jets RBs behind Hall.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Stefon Diggs both OUT (hamstrings). Quentin Johnston OUT; Michael Pittman OUT (later IR).
items.why: Hamstring for Smith/Diggs; chest for Johnston; foot for Pittman (IR confirmed).
items.implication: PHI/WAS/LAC/PIT WR depth charts shift; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: A.J. Brown, remaining WAS WRs, LAC WRs, Steelers WRs upgraded roles.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Foot and ankle; elevation of handcuff signals caution.
items.implication: Game-time; monitor for OUT and Hemby opportunity.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated RB gets work.

items.text: Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum 4 games.
items.implication: Longer absence; PIT WR depth permanent upgrade short-term.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and remaining Steelers WRs full target share.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr had only 5 catches in 4 games; not a real factor impacting Michael Wilson stuff. Kia Kendrick Bourne szn incoming post-trade.
items.why: Low production already; Wilson volume independent and now clearer.
items.implication: Wilson primary beneficiary; Bourne or others next.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown (RB5 @MIA); nickname push 'Brown Gobbler'. Workload + Bengals injury context + soft run D.
items.why: Gobbles targets/points; Bengals WR injuries may funnel more; MIA matchup.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love IN (not on final report); Jayden Daniels IN; Chris Olave IN; Dallas Goedert IN.
items.why: Cleared/full or not listed; Love ankle maintenance but full-go comments.
items.implication: Expected starters; reverse any prior backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Love workload projected up; Daniels/Olave/Goedert full roles.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection but expected much better role this week despite ankle maintenance; 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Not on final IR; fans/media usage criticism may help.
items.why: Prior low usage backlash + cleared; gut says better role, account for downside.
items.implication: Start-worthy RB with clear path over committee mate.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry share expected vs prior week.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins (WR8 @TEN volume/RZ), Michael Wilson (WR10 vsDET), Christian Watson (WR15 vsCHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @WSH). Usage + soft matchups.
items.why: Target hogs, red-zone work, defenses struggling vs WR/TE.
items.implication: Strong start recommendations; Wilson boosted by MHJ news.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies. Frustration over late-game targets noted.
items.why: Stacked injury + usage frustration + scheme/QB risks; great player but sideways potential.
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term playable but ROS caution.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison (WR41 injury/matchup), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15 rough stretch/line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency/game script concerns, Hurts banged-up line.
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats this week.
